hook: Your map of South Africa shows three capitals.
title: Your map shows 3 capitals in one country
description:
South Africa has three capital cities, and each one holds a different branch of government. Pretoria is the executive capital, Cape Town is the legislative capital, and Bloemfontein is the judicial capital. Places That Shouldn't Exist, part of our daily series.

#Shorts #SouthAfrica #Geography
comment_prompt: Which capital would you visit first? Pretoria, Cape Town or Bloemfontein
